english:
Passively grants 10% decreased Handling Animation Duration and 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration to <primary/>Primary weapons.

Increases <primary/>Primary Weapon damage against <link non-Boss Combatants [#CombatantClassifications] /> based on your Weapons Stat. The following increases are relative to damage at the same Weapons Stat without this set bonus:
• 0.6%|1.2%|1.8%|2.4%|3% at 20|40|60|80|100 Weapons Stat
• 4.75%|6.6%|8.35%|10.2%|12% at 120|140|160|180|200 Weapons Stat

source.text:
2 Piece | Primary Honing

0.9x Handling Duration Multiplier and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons.

Increased Primary Weapon Damage against Non-Boss Combatants based on the Weapons stat.

Compared to the damage dealt at the equivalent Weapons Stat:
20 Stat = 0.6% | 40 = 1.2% | 60 = 1.8% | 80 = 2.4% | 100 = 3%
120 = 4.75% | 140 = 6.6% | 160 = 8.35% | 180 = 10.2% | 200 = 12%
